summary: Iteration 6 (FINAL DIGNITY & FUNERAL FUND — final module before Publish) validated end-to-end. BACKEND (16/16 pytest — test_phase7.py): GET /api/dignity/fund auto-creates {balance:0, status:'locked', death_verified:false, currency:'EUR'}; user with proxy-directive gets beneficiary auto-defaulted to proxy_full_name 'Tomáš Novák' (type:'proxy', auto:true); user without proxy gets no beneficiary. POST /api/dignity/fund/deposit {amount:50,currency:'EUR',method:'card'} → balance 50, ledger_hash 64-hex returned, mocked:true; amount=0 and amount=-10 both rejected with 422. PUT /api/dignity/fund/plan {monthly_amount:20,enabled:true} → next GET auto-applies +20 once (balance 50→70, last_plan_run='2026-08'), second GET does NOT double-apply (balance stays 70), contributions list contains method:'recurring' entry. POST /api/dignity/release before verify → 403 with 'locked' in error message. POST /api/dignity/verify-death cert='UL' (5 chars) → 400 'Invalid death certificate number format'; cert='UL-2026-9999' → 200 verified:true simulated:true certificate_number+registry_country echoed. USER_B verified but no beneficiary + no proxy → release 400 'No beneficiary designated'. USER_A PUT /api/dignity/beneficiary {type:'proxy', name:''} → 200 with name auto-filled to 'Tomáš Novák' from proxy directive. USER_B PUT beneficiary {type:'funeral_director', name:'Pohrebná Bratislava s.r.o.'} + deposit 100 + release → 200 released:true amount:100 to.type=funeral_director; GET shows balance:0 status:'released' released_to.name matches; second release → 400 'Already released'; deposit after release → 400 'Fund already released'. PUT /api/dignity/wishes {burial_type:'cremation',ceremony_music:'Hallelujah',guest_list:'Rodina + susedia',notes:'Bez smútku'} → 200 with doc_hash 64-hex; GET /api/dignity/fund.wishes reflects saved data. AML ledger (verified via pymongo direct read + SHA256 recomputation): USER_A contains dignity_deposit + dignity_recurring + death_verification; USER_B contains dignity_deposit + death_verification + dignity_release; each entry's stored entry_hash matches sha256(json.dumps({seq,user_id,action,payload,prev:prev_hash},sort_keys=True)) — chain integrity confirmed. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844, gh_session_token injected via add_init_script, fresh Mongo session w/ tos_accepted_version pre-seeded): /dignity screen (dignity-screen) renders with 'UZAMKNUTÉ DO OVERENIA ÚMRTIA' locked banner, dg-balance='0'; deposit flow dg-amount='30' + dg-deposit → balance 30; recurring plan (dg-plan-amount + dg-plan-enabled switch + dg-plan-save) auto-applies on next GET (verified 40→55 in prior seedless run); wishes form (dg-burial-cremation + dg-music='Hallelujah' + dg-guests + dg-wishes-save) shows '✓ POSLEDNÉ PRIANIA ULOŽENÉ'; death trigger dg-cert='UL-2026-FE02' + dg-verify → dg-release button appears → release shows '✓ UVOĽNENÉ 30 EUR → Tomáš Novák' toast + UVOĽNENÉ state on fund card + released_to line '→ Tomáš Novák (30 EUR)'. Navigation: Profile dignity-btn (present, tap → /dignity), Solidarity sol-dignity-link (tap → /dignity), Legal lg-dignity-link (tap → /dignity) — all 3 work. Jarvis advice (jarvis-advice-dignity_fund) returned 706-char SK LLM response starting 'JARVIS Dobrý deň, som Jarvis, váš AI asistent – chcem byť transparentný, že som umelá inteligencia...'. No red screens, no deprecated packages introduced in dignity.tsx (expo-router + react-native-safe-area-context + @expo/vector-icons — all current).
action_items: OPTIONAL / low-priority: _aml_ledger_append computes prev_hash from the GLOBAL last entry (db.aml_ledger.find_one({}, sort=[('seq',-1)])) — this creates a single global chain across all users. Fine for a system-wide audit ledger, but if per-user chain isolation ever becomes a requirement, filter last/seq lookup by user_id. Chain integrity was verified in tests via SHA256 recomputation.

OPTIONAL: _apply_recurring uses YYYY-MM (UTC) as the 'has-run' key — a user in UTC+2 who enables plan on the 1st of the month at 00:30 CEST (23:30 UTC prev month) will see the recurring apply for the PREVIOUS UTC month first, then again ~30 hrs later when UTC ticks over. Same UTC-day caveat noted in iteration 5.

OPTIONAL: /api/dignity/release POST body is empty (no explicit beneficiary override) — a proxy/family member releasing on behalf of a deceased user has no way to override the beneficiary at release time via the API (must PUT beneficiary first). Consider allowing an optional beneficiary in the POST body for one-shot overrides.

OPTIONAL: server.py is now 2129 lines — /legal, /meds, /aml, /solidarity, /dignity should each be extracted into route modules (flagged in iterations 4 and 5, still not done). Before Publish this would improve maintainability but is not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: dignity_deposit: mocked payment rail with real AML ledger append — status:'released' pre-check correctly blocks post-release deposits (returns 400 not 422). Verified.

_apply_recurring: idempotent via last_plan_run == current-YYYY-MM check; recurring contribution has method:'recurring' + mocked:true; single insert + single $inc + single ledger append per apply. Verified no double-apply on consecutive GETs.
dignity_verify_death: len(cert.strip()) < 6 rejects — SIMULATED state registry (documented as production hook point in test spec, not a bug). Returns simulated:true flag so FE can badge it.

dignity_release: two-tier beneficiary resolution — fund.beneficiary → proxy_directive → 400. released_to snapshot preserved on fund doc so post-release GET shows historical beneficiary even if proxy is later deleted. Verified.

dignity.tsx release() handler correctly maps 'locked' error substring to Slovak banner '🔒 FOND JE UZAMKNUTÝ DO OVERENIA ÚMRTIA' — but on 400 responses (e.g. No beneficiary) it shows the raw JSON error. Consider parsing r.detail for cleaner UX.
dignity.tsx uses <Switch> for dg-plan-enabled which renders as HTML checkbox on web; tap works. No touchTarget concerns.
AML ledger: entry_hash chain uses global sort by seq — see action_items #1.
